title: Wangan Dead Heat + Real Arrange
native_title: 湾岸デッドヒート＋リアル・アレンジ
overview: Wangan Dead Heat + Real Arrange is an updated release of Wangan Dead Heat. This version features a new cast of companion models to impress with your racing skills; five real-life race models appear in video form. There is no new content such as tracks or cars, but the gameplay has been tweaked and adjusted, and there is a second disc included which contains video clips of each of the models.
